# CM&F Group

> CM&F Group is a professional liability and malpractice insurance provider specializing in comprehensive coverage for healthcare professionals across multiple specialties and practice settings.

CM&F Group offers tailored insurance solutions for individual practitioners, student healthcare professionals, group practices, healthcare institutions, and telehealth providers. The company partners with A.M. Best-rated carriers to deliver risk management resources and coverage across diverse medical specialties including nursing, physical therapy, mental health, acupuncture, chiropractic, and specialized practices like MedSpa and home health.

## Key Topics

- Professional Liability Insurance
- Malpractice Insurance
- Healthcare Professionals
- Risk Management
- Telemedicine/Telehealth
- Nurse Practitioner
- Physician Assistant

- Liability Coverage
